notes: TBox delete of a stored rule. Members stay in the class in every world; a world with the member's value stored by name keeps it, a world that reached it only through the rule loses it (stores). The two responses to shear are individuals ('thicker' = more viscous as shear rises); the delete's answers are the original or does-not-know, so none rests on one response per fluid and the earlier firm one-value rule is dropped (2026-10-31). 'Resists like a solid when struck' is thickening (the record's w1 chain).
